captions.text: Soft light, honest mood, and a little main-character energy.
A small reminder that I can be proud of how far I have come.
Not perfect, just becoming more myself every day.
A quiet kind of confidence looks good on me.
Keeping the version of me that felt happy in this moment.
Plans change, the group chat stays chaotic.
The best memories usually start with 'one quick photo'.
Different personalities, one very loud camera roll.
Friendship is mostly laughing at things nobody else understands.
A little chaos with my favourite people.
Ordinary days become special when we share them.
Home is the people who make room for you.
Saving this moment for the stories we'll tell later.
The familiar faces are still my favourite view.
Tradition in our hearts, new memories in every frame.
The lights, the colours, the feeling of being together.
One celebration, countless little moments worth keeping.
Dressed for the occasion, staying for the memories.
A new place has a way of changing the pace of a day.
Taking the scenic route whenever life lets me.
A little further from routine, a little closer to myself.
Collecting views that photos can only partly explain.
The world gets quieter when I stop long enough to notice.
A little sky, a little breeze, and nowhere to rush.
Proof that a pause can be productive too.
Some views make the mind feel lighter.
A promise, a beginning, and a thousand little memories ahead.
The day felt fast; the feeling will stay a long time.
A beautiful chapter made brighter by our people.
Good food, good company, and no need to hurry.
The first bite deserved its own photograph.
Some memories are best served warm.
Tiny paws, huge personality, permanent place in my heart.
The unofficial manager of this household has arrived.
Finding beauty in the details I nearly walked past.
Less noise, softer light, more room to breathe.
A frame that feels like a deep breath.
We showed up, made memories, and forgot to check the time.
A good day made better by the people in it.
Shubho Bijoya. The goodbye is hard, but Ma will return. ❤️
captions.bengali: শুভ বিজয়া। বিদায়টা কঠিন, তবু মা আবার আসবেন। ❤️

captions.text: Sindoor, smiles, teary eyes, and one promise: asche bochor abar hobe.
captions.bengali: সিঁদুর, হাসি, ভেজা চোখ আর একটাই কথা—আসছে বছর আবার হবে।

captions.text: The puja ends today; the feeling stays with us all year.
captions.bengali: আজ পুজো শেষ, কিন্তু অনুভূতিটা সারা বছর থেকে যাবে।

captions.text: One last pranam to Ma, carrying a heart full of memories. 🙏
captions.bengali: মাকে শেষ প্রণাম, হৃদয়ভরা স্মৃতি নিয়ে। 🙏

captions.text: Dashami is a little celebration and a little heartbreak.
captions.bengali: দশমী মানে একটু আনন্দ, আর একটু মনখারাপ।

captions.text: Until next year, Ma. Keep everyone safe until we meet again. ❤️
captions.bengali: আবার দেখা হবে আগামী বছর, মা। ততদিন সবাইকে ভালো রেখো। ❤️

captions.text: The lights will fade, the photos will stay, and the memories will return every autumn.
captions.bengali: আলো নিভে যাবে, ছবি থেকে যাবে, আর প্রতি শরতে স্মৃতিগুলো ফিরে আসবে।

captions.text: A final day of puja, a thousand feelings, and countless memories.
captions.bengali: পুজোর শেষ দিন, হাজার অনুভূতি আর অসংখ্য স্মৃতি।

captions.text: Four days of colour, devotion, friends, and memories I wish I could pause.
captions.bengali: চার দিনের রং, ভক্তি, বন্ধুত্ব আর থামিয়ে রাখতে ইচ্ছে করা স্মৃতি।

captions.text: From pandal hopping to the last dhak beat, every moment felt special.
captions.bengali: প্যান্ডেল ঘোরা থেকে ঢাকের শেষ তালে—প্রতিটি মুহূর্তই ছিল বিশেষ।

captions.text: New outfits, familiar faces, and the magic of coming together.
captions.bengali: নতুন পোশাক, চেনা মুখ আর একসঙ্গে হওয়ার আনন্দ।

captions.text: Dhak in the air, lights all around, and Ma in every heart. ❤️
captions.bengali: চারদিকে ঢাকের সুর, আলো আর সবার হৃদয়ে মা। ❤️

captions.text: A little tired from the crowds, a lot happier because of the memories.
captions.bengali: ভিড়ে একটু ক্লান্ত, স্মৃতিগুলোর জন্য অনেক বেশি খুশি।

captions.text: The best part of Puja is finding your people in the crowd.
captions.bengali: পুজোর সেরা মুহূর্ত হলো ভিড়ের মাঝে নিজের মানুষদের খুঁজে পাওয়া।

captions.text: Every pandal tells a story; every photo keeps a little piece of Puja.
captions.bengali: প্রতিটি প্যান্ডেলের নিজস্ব গল্প, প্রতিটি ছবিতে পুজোর একটুকরো স্মৃতি।

captions.text: Ma's home for a few days, memories for a lifetime.
captions.bengali: কয়েক দিনের জন্য মায়ের ঘর, সারাজীবনের জন্য স্মৃতি।
